app_fee.value: Registering for the doctorate through eApply costs CHF 150 for graduates of foreign universities (CHF 50 for other Swiss graduates, free for ETH/EPFL graduates); a one-time CHF 1,500 tuition fee is charged later, after registration for the doctoral examination.
app_fee.quote: Registration fee for graduates from abroad CHF 150.00

also.quote: To complete your registration you will be directed automatically to the payments page for the payment of the application fee.

fee_waiver.value: No fee waiver for foreign graduates is mentioned; only ETH Zurich/EPFL graduates register free of charge.

gre_general.value: ETH's central admission requirements (a Master's degree and a professor who offers you a position) do not mention the GRE.

toefl_min.value: No TOEFL minimum: ETH does not require an official English certificate to register for the doctorate, though strong written and spoken English is expected.
toefl_min.quote: ETH Zürich does not require an official language certificate in English such as the TOEFL etc. to register for the doctorate.

ielts_min.value: No IELTS minimum: ETH does not require any official English certificate for doctoral registration.
ielts_min.quote: ETH Zürich does not require an official language certificate in English such as the TOEFL etc. to register for the doctorate.

english_waiver.value: No English test is required of any doctoral applicant, so Indian applicants with an English-medium degree need no TOEFL/IELTS; your supervisor will still expect strong English.
english_waiver.quote: ETH Zürich does not require an official language certificate in English such as the TOEFL etc. to register for the doctorate. | Nevertheless, applicants are expected to possess a strong proficiency in both written and spoken English.

notes: Individual doctorate model: you first find an ETH professor who offers you a (usually salaried) doctoral position, then register via eApply. No central deadline. Fees: CHF 150 registration (foreign degree), CHF 1,500 one-time tuition at the end, CHF 42 compulsory semester fees.
